name: app-and-report-with-ai
description: Two products and one modelling language. This manifest covers only the root-level language folder; each subfolder has its own.

scripts.check:all: bun run check:models && bun run check:protocol && bun run type-check && bun run check:language-tools && bun run check:stacks && bun run check:clis && bun run check:pack
scripts._comment:clis: Two CLIs, one runtime: `appwithai` and `appwithai-wasm` both run on bun 1.4.4, what app-with-ai-tanstack requires throughout. `check:clis` runs both under whichever bun is on PATH and prints which; CI runs each in a job of its own so they go side by side — see .github/workflows/root-ci.yml.
scripts._comment:type-check: bun check is Bun's own type checker (1.4.3+; this project pins 1.4.4). No script here may be named `check`: Bun runs a package script of that name in preference to the built-in, so `bun check` would quietly run the whole chain instead of type-checking. The aggregate is `check:all` for that reason. An older Bun fails with "Script not found" rather than passing.
scripts._comment:language-tools: html/checker.js and html/fixer.js are bundled from language/browser/*.entry.ts, and each one inlines language/appwithai-language.json. Editing the definition or the checker stales them, and nothing else notices — so `--check` runs in `check` and fails rather than serving a validator that disagrees with this repository's own language. website/viewers/eml-model.js is NOT built here: its entry lives in the app-with-ai-tanstack checkout and imports that repository's language copy, so it is carried across from there.
